title: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer
provenance: Reported by DanielAdomian (highball-db#1058, 2026-11-07), Apple , macOS , engine , , rated  of 5. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Doesn't start yet in one report on an M1 Mac mini: the game ends itself right after starting, before it opens a window, on the Wine 10 and Wine 11 engines. The Steam release carries Denuvo Anti-Tamper (store page).

knownIssues.symptom: Exits right after starting, before any window (M1, Wine 10 engines and Wine 11 r28 and r30)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The game's main thread raises exception c0000409, the code a Windows program uses to stop itself at once, right after a run of system information queries Wine doesn't answer (NtQuerySystemInformation stub lines) and before any graphics device exists, so the graphics mode isn't involved (the reporter's +loaddll trace, highball-db#1058)

knownIssues.symptom: Epic Online Services fails to install on the Wine 10 engines (SetNamedSecurityInfo error 120, MSI error 1603)
knownIssues.cause: error 120 means the call isn't implemented, a Windows security call Wine 10 lacks for what the installer asks (the reporter's reading)
